Its FoodRx program combines host-genetics and gut-microbiome testing with app-based coaching, precision nutrition, and pre/probiotic therapies, delivered to members through health plans and employers. Digbi Health is backed by Accel. The company operates a consumer-facing storefront and member app rather than a public developer API; this profile captures the public web, agent, and security surfaces observable at digbihealth.com.

providers.name: Dorsata
providers.description: Dorsata is a women's health technology company based in Arlington, Virginia that reimagines the electronic health record (EHR) experience for obstetrics and gynecology providers, life sciences, and health plans. Its flagship Dorsata Prenatal platform overlays a practice's existing EHR with an ACOG-aligned prenatal flowsheet and a clinical rules engine that surfaces the right guidance at the right point of care, improving diagnosis, treatment, and documentation while reducing physician burnout. Additional products include Dorsata Insights, which gathers standardized real-world clinical data from women's health providers (including populations historically underrepresented in clinical studies), Dorsata Pathways, and an Adnexal Mass solution. The platform serves 300+ practice sites and thousands of clinical users across roughly 20 states, documenting hundreds of thousands of pregnancies. Dorsata raised a $5.2M Series A with participation from QED Investors, Women's Health USA, LabCorp, Fool Ventures, and Gore Range Capital. This API Evangelist profile tracks Dorsata as a healthtech company; the company exposes no public developer API surface at this time.

providers.name: Ennoble Care
providers.description: Ennoble Care is a physician-led home-based healthcare provider delivering primary care, palliative care, and hospice care to seniors in the comfort of their own homes. Founded to bring the doctor back to the housecall, the company offers in-home primary care and chronic disease management, post-acute care transitions, advance care planning, bereavement services, and respite care across 13 states and Washington, DC (Alabama, Florida, Georgia, Kansas, Maryland, Missouri, New Jersey, New York, Oklahoma, Pennsylvania, Texas, and Virginia). Ennoble Care is a portfolio company of Norwest Venture Partners. This profile has been enriched by the API Evangelist network; Ennoble Care is a healthcare-services company and publishes no public developer API, SDKs, or developer portal at this time.

providers.name: Enzo Biochem
providers.description: Enzo Biochem, Inc. (operating as Enzo Life Sciences) is a life sciences company specializing in labeling and detection technologies for biomedical research and drug development. Trading under the tagline "Scientists Enabling Scientists," Enzo develops and manufactures research reagents and assays including AMPIVIEW RNA probes for in-situ hybridization and FISH, antibodies, ELISA immunoassays, immunohistochemistry (IHC) products, and CELLESTIAL cell-based assays. Its biopharma arm provides drug discovery services, target identification and validation, assay development, in vitro toxicology, and GMP manufacturing. Products are sold through an online catalog and account portal at enzo.com rather than a public developer API. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a stub company lead and enriched with the identity, website, and domain-security posture that could be verified from public sources.

providers.name: FitOn
providers.description: FitOn is a consumer digital fitness and wellness platform offering free, on-demand workout classes (cardio, strength, yoga, Pilates, HIIT), guided meditation, personalized meal plans and nutrition tracking, recipes, and social challenges. FitOn serves 15 million+ members with celebrity and world-class trainers across mobile, web, and connected-TV apps (Apple TV, Roku, Chromecast, Fire TV). Its FitOn Health arm delivers an enterprise wellness benefit to employers, health plans, and brokers. FitOn is backed by Accel. As of this enrichment pass FitOn publishes no public developer API, developer portal, SDKs, or OpenAPI; consumer and B2B integration is handled through partnership programs rather than a self-serve API.

providers.name: GetHarley
providers.description: GetHarley is a UK-based telehealth and skincare platform delivering personalised, medical-grade skincare through online consultations. Patients answer questions about their skin concerns, book a video consultation, and are matched with one of a network of over 1,000 licensed dermatologists, aesthetic doctors, and plastic surgeons, who recommend a tailored regimen of medical-grade products delivered to the patient. GetHarley operates both a patient-facing storefront and a practitioner platform used by clinicians to manage recommendations, orders, and client relationships. Backed by Index Ventures, the company addresses concerns such as acne, fine lines, pigmentation, and ageing. As of this profile, GetHarley does not publish a public developer API, SDKs, or an MCP server; this record captures its identity, web properties, and probed domain-security posture for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: heva
providers.description: heva is an AI-native healthcare and medical-tourism platform that connects patients with vetted medical practices, specialists, and providers across borders, with an initial focus on Spanish-speaking markets. The platform offers practice discovery by specialty and location, deposit-based online appointment booking, a conversational AI booking assistant (Heva AI), an online store for purchasing procedures and services, and secure payments via Stripe. Provider-facing tools cover practice management, patient acquisition, communications, and appointment coordination, delivered through the web and native iOS and Android provider apps. heva is a Techstars-backed company building "care without borders."

providers.name: Ophelia
providers.description: Ophelia is a telehealth company delivering online treatment for opioid use disorder (OUD) through medication-assisted treatment (MAT). Founded in 2020 and based in Philadelphia, Ophelia combines evidence-based buprenorphine/naloxone (Suboxone) prescriptions with virtual clinical care, delivering diagnosis, prescriptions sent to local pharmacies, ongoing clinician support, and insurance coordination entirely remotely. Patients can be seen within 1-3 days and most pay under $10/month. Ophelia is a consumer-facing healthcare provider and does not publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; this profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network as a company record.

providers.name: Prosper Health
providers.description: Prosper Health is a telehealth provider focused exclusively on autistic and neurodivergent adults, offering virtual autism diagnostic assessments and ongoing affirming, strength-based therapy delivered by licensed psychologists and therapists who specialize in adult autism. Its adult-validated, telehealth-native assessment (an alternative to the child-oriented ADOS) runs entirely online across two psychologist sessions plus a feedback session, with results reported within roughly two weeks. Prosper Health accepts major insurers (Aetna, BCBS, Cigna, Oscar, Oxford, United) across 20-plus US states. It is a direct-to-consumer clinical care company with no public developer API surface; this profile tracks its web, security, and identity properties for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Sesame
providers.description: Sesame is a direct-to-consumer telehealth marketplace that connects patients with board-certified clinicians for affordable, transparent, cash-pay virtual and in-person care. Patients browse and book pay-per-visit appointments starting around $34 across urgent care, prescription refills, weight loss and GLP-1 treatment, mental health, women's health, dermatology, pediatrics and more, with no insurance required and up-front pricing. The company also offers a SesamePlus membership, a mobile app, provider tooling for listing a practice, and Sesame @ Work employer plans. Sesame is backed by General Catalyst, GV, Matrix Partners, Redpoint Ventures, Spark Capital and SV Angel. As of this enrichment pass Sesame publishes a consumer web and mobile experience but no public developer API, developer portal, SDKs, or OpenAPI surface. It operates a private Apollo GraphQL endpoint at api.sesamecare.com/graphql that backs its own apps — anonymous requests return 401 and introspection is disabled in production — and its public GitHub organization publishes 17 general-purpose Node/TypeScript utility packages under the @sesamecare-oss npm scope rather than first-party API client SDKs.

providers.name: Sondermind
providers.description: SonderMind is a Denver-based mental health company operating a measurement-based behavioral healthcare platform that connects people to licensed therapists and psychiatrists who have availability, accept insurance, and specialize in their needs. It offers virtual and in-person therapy and psychiatry across all 50 U.S. states, along with enterprise offerings for health systems, physician practices, payers, and Veterans. SonderMind is a General Catalyst portfolio company. As of this profile it publishes a consumer and clinician web platform (with a member/provider sign-in at api.sondermind.com) but no public developer API, developer portal, SDKs, or API documentation; this repository tracks SonderMind's public web, content, and identity surface for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Tooth Fairy
providers.description: Toothfairy is a UK dental telehealth platform billing itself as the world's first dentist on-demand, pairing registered dentists with a consumer mobile app to deliver teeth straightening with clear aligners, prescription teeth whitening, and same-day emergency video dental consultations 24/7, plus employer dental plans for businesses. The company is health-regulated in the UK, backed by Seedcamp, and ships its product as iOS and Android apps with no public developer API surface.

providers.name: Centivo
providers.description: Centivo is a primary-care-centered health plan administrator for self-funded employers, founded in 2017 and headquartered in New York City. Sold through benefits brokers and consultants, it serves mid-market employers (roughly 50 or more employees) and covers about 77,000 members across 160 businesses. Members get $0 primary care to encourage early intervention, and employers typically save 15-30% versus traditional fully-insured plans through a primary-care-first model, the cost advantages of self-funding, and directly negotiated health-system partnerships. Centivo operates member, employer, provider, and referral portals plus iOS/Android member apps; it does not publish a public developer API. Backed by Bain Capital Ventures and JPMorgan Chase's Morgan Health.

providers.name: Dalma
providers.description: Dalma is a French insurtech offering pet health insurance for dogs and cats, reimbursing veterinary bills (up to 100%, no deductible, EUR 2,500 annual ceiling) with fast payouts (50% within 30 seconds) and unlimited teleconsultations with veterinarians via its mobile app. Founded in Paris and backed by Northzone, Dalma insures 60,000+ pets across France and has expanded to Germany. It is a direct-to-consumer insurance brand with a member app (app.dalma.co) and a quote/subscription funnel; it publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI definition, SDK, or developer portal at this time.

providers.name: Doctolib
providers.description: Doctolib is a European e-health company founded in 2013 and headquartered in Levallois-Perret, France, operating across France, Germany, Italy and the Netherlands. It provides an online medical appointment-booking platform and practice-management software used by patients and by hundreds of thousands of healthcare professionals and facilities. Its product surface spans appointment booking, telehealth/video consultation, patient messaging, clinical software, patient billing, and the Doctolib Connect integration and single-sign-on layer. Doctolib exposes a partner/integration API via an authentication-gated developer portal (developers.doctolib.com); it publishes an RFC 9116 security.txt and runs a public YesWeHack bug-bounty program, an Atlassian Statuspage, and an open-source GitHub organization, but does not publish a public OpenAPI specification, first-party API SDK, or hosted MCP server.

providers.name: Sofía
providers.description: Sofía is a 100% Mexican health insurance company (aseguradora) offering medical coverage for individuals, families, and businesses, delivered primarily through a mobile app with plans that carry no deductibles. Regulated in Mexico by the CNSF, Secretaría de Salud, and CONDUSEF, and backed by Index Ventures. This is a consumer/enterprise insurance provider surfaced as a portfolio-company lead; a live probe of the public surface found no developer program, API, or /.well-known/ discovery documents, so this profile remains identity-only pending any future API exposure.

providers.name: Amperos Health
providers.description: Amperos Health (Amperos) is an AI-native insurance revenue recovery platform for healthcare providers. It uses agentic AI together with experienced revenue cycle management (RCM) specialists to run the full insurance collections process, from claim submission through denial resolution to payment. The platform automates first-touch routine tasks, works complex denials with specialist oversight, and adapts configurable workflows to each organization's procedures across specialties including orthopedics, cardiology, behavioral health, DME/HME, ophthalmology, anesthesiology, dermatology, urology, dental, and oncology. Amperos reports outcomes such as higher claim recovery, reduced accounts receivable backlogs, and lower cost to collect for the healthcare providers it serves. The company is backed by Uncork Capital and surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a venture-portfolio company. Amperos currently exposes a marketing and demo-request surface rather than a public developer API; this profile captures its public web properties and security posture.

providers.name: Activ Surgical
providers.description: Activ Surgical is a Boston, Massachusetts digital surgery company building intraoperative surgical intelligence for the operating room. Its flagship product, the ActivSight Intelligent Light imaging module, attaches to existing laparoscopic and robotic surgical systems and renders augmented-reality overlays on a standard monitor, letting surgeons see physiology the naked eye cannot. ActivPerfusion delivers dye-free, real-time blood-perfusion imaging using laser speckle contrast imaging, while ActivICG supports conventional indocyanine green visualization of structures such as bile ducts. The module is powered by the ActivEdge platform, a hardware-agnostic computer-vision, AI and machine-learning stack the company is building to turn intraoperative data into real-time surgical guidance. Activ Surgical performed the first autonomous robotic soft-tissue surgery in 2018, received FDA 510(k) clearance for ActivSight in April 2021 and CE Mark approval in December 2022, and sells on a subscription model with no capital-equipment purchase. The company publishes no public developer program, API, SDK or machine-readable API contract as of this profiling pass; its public technical surface is regulatory (EU MDR declarations of conformity, ISO 13485:2016) and clinical (peer-reviewed studies and white papers).

providers.name: Alem Health
providers.description: AlemHealth is an AI-powered teleradiology and medical imaging platform that unifies image acquisition, diagnostic reading, reporting, and analytics into a single cloud system used by 500+ radiologists across 20+ countries. Its product suite includes Connect PACS (cloud image archiving with an FDA-approved diagnostic viewer), FrontDesk RIS scheduling, a referring-physician Referral Portal, a patient QR-access app, and the AlemBox gateway and AlemHub reporting-server hardware. AI features cover automated report drafting, quality-assurance scoring, laterality-mismatch detection, and ICD-10 tagging, metered via an AI-tokens model. For providers, AlemHealth supports bi-directional HL7, FHIR, and API integrations plus standard DICOM connectivity to sync orders, patient demographics, and finalized reports with existing EMR/EHR and PACS systems.

providers.name: Bioniq
providers.description: Bioniq is a personalized nutrition and supplement company founded in London in 2019 that combines individual biomarker and blood-test data with a proprietary algorithm to formulate customized vitamin and mineral blends delivered as Swiss-made granules. Its consumer product line spans Bioniq GO (wellness-assessment based), Bioniq PRO (blood-test driven), and Bioniq Essential, supported by iOS and Android apps for tracking health and supplement routines. Bioniq is a portfolio company of HV Capital and now operates within Herbalife. It exposes consumer web, mobile, and partner/affiliate surfaces but publishes no public developer API, SDK, or API documentation as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: Blink Health
providers.description: Blink Health is a healthcare technology company that operates BlinkRx, a digital pharmacy platform connecting patients, prescribers, and pharmaceutical manufacturers to simplify prescription access, fulfillment, and affordability. The platform streamlines the path from a provider writing a prescription to a patient receiving medication at a transparent price, with copay support, home delivery, and manufacturer-sponsored programs. Backed by 8vc, Blink Health runs consumer-facing prescription-savings tools and a provider/pharma-facing BlinkRx offering. No public developer API program or documentation was found during enrichment; a live undocumented API host exists at api.blinkhealth.com.

providers.name: Casana
providers.description: Casana (Casana Care) is a Rochester, New York digital-health company building passive, in-home remote patient monitoring hardware. Its flagship Smart Seat (formerly the Heart Seat) is a toilet-seat replacement that captures vital signs — heart rate, heart-rate variability, blood-oxygen (SpO2), respiration rate, blood-pressure insights, and sit-to-stand power — during normal bathroom use, with no wearables, no daily charging, and explicitly no camera or microphone. Readings sync to companion iOS, Android, and web apps for patients, families, and caregivers. The company operates in the digital health, remote patient monitoring, and connected medical-device space and is backed by General Catalyst and Kaiser Permanente. As of this profile Casana publishes a consumer product, companion apps, and legal/privacy pages, but no public developer program, API, or documentation surface.

providers.name: Margo
providers.description: Margo is a Linux Foundation open standard initiative for interoperability at the edge of industrial automation ecosystems. Founded by ABB, Capgemini, Microsoft, Rockwell Automation, Schneider Electric, and Siemens, it defines mechanisms for interoperability between edge applications, devices, and orchestration software.

providers.name: Medeloop
providers.description: Medeloop is an AI platform for the clinical research lifecycle, describing itself as an operating system for clinical research that spans grant discovery and funding, real-world evidence generation from patient data, and delivering actionable intelligence at the point of care. Its products include Medeloop Analytics (AI agents that analyze EHR, claims, and registry data without requiring users to code), EvidenceKit (analytics paired with all-payer claims data), Medeloop Grants (AI-assisted grant discovery and proposal writing), and Medeloop Care (population health and care management). The platform is federated (compute moves to the data, which stays in the customer's infrastructure), CDM-agnostic (Epic, Cerner, Meditech, OMOP, i2b2, or custom schemas), and model-agnostic (routing tasks across OpenAI, Anthropic, or DeepSeek), with multi-cloud deployment across AWS, Azure, GCP, and on-premise. It serves pharmaceutical and life-sciences companies, health systems, and clinical researchers. As of this enrichment pass Medeloop publishes no public API, developer portal, or OpenAPI specification; its documentation host (docs.medeloop.ai) is gated behind Okta authentication and its analytics application is a private client login.

providers.name: MedHOK (Hearst Communications)
providers.description: MHK (formerly MedHOK), part of Hearst Health, is a healthcare technology company providing a unified SaaS platform for health plans and payers. Its CareProminence suite spans utilization management, care management, complaints/appeals and grievances, pharmacy management, population health and quality management, and interoperability (the MHK Interop Suite), while its MarketProminence suite covers enrollment and member maintenance, premium billing, financial reconciliation, and member web portals. MHK helps Medicare, Medicaid, and commercial health plans streamline operations, ensure regulatory compliance, and improve the member experience. The MHK Interop Suite supports FHIR, SMART on FHIR, Da Vinci, and CMS-0057 interoperability requirements. MHK publishes HITRUST and ISO 27001 certification and NCQA prevalidation. The company operates a public marketing and resource site but does not publish a public developer portal or API program.

providers.name: Tasso
providers.description: Tasso, Inc. designs painless, needle-free blood collection devices and an end-to-end logistics platform for decentralized and at-home blood sampling. Its product line includes Tasso+ for capillary whole-blood collection, the Tasso-M20/Mini for dried blood microsampling, and the tile-T20 for liquid serum and plasma, enabling remote specimen collection for clinical trials, patient screening, diagnostics, and research. Tasso pairs the hardware with kitting, shipping, and sample-return logistics and is cited in over 100 peer-reviewed publications. It was surfaced as a Techstars portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network. No public developer API surface was found at the time of enrichment.

providers.name: AvoMD
providers.description: AvoMD (Avo) is a clinical AI platform that integrates directly with electronic health record (EHR) systems to power AI copilots for healthcare workflows. It combines EHR data with trusted clinical knowledge bases to support decision-making, documentation, and care delivery across inpatient and outpatient settings. Avo's product line includes Chart Assist, an AI Scribe for ambient clinical documentation, and AI Consult, serving rural and small hospitals, large and mid-size hospitals, and ambulatory care, in partnership with medical societies and knowledge partners. The company is SOC 2 Type II compliant and backed by 500 Global.

providers.name: Besoundbreast
providers.description: BeSound (Besoundbreast) is a women's-health technology platform offering modern, radiation-free breast imaging using ABUS ultrasound to help find cancers that mammograms can miss, particularly in women with dense breast tissue. BeSound connects patients with independent partner medical groups who deliver the imaging; results reach a secure patient portal within 24-48 weekday hours. Screening breast ultrasound is $349, with locations in Los Angeles (Melrose Ave) and Beverly Hills. BeSound is a consumer healthcare service and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or developer portal; this profile captures its public identity and the machine-readable llms.txt it publishes for AI agents.

providers.name: Freed
providers.description: Freed is a San Francisco-based AI medical scribe and clinician assistant designed to reduce the documentation burden on healthcare providers. The product listens to patient visits and generates SOAP-style clinical notes, visit summaries, patient instructions, referral letters, and ICD-10 / CPT coding suggestions, then transfers the finalized note into the clinician's EHR via a browser-resident agent. Freed was founded in 2023 by former Facebook engineers Erez Druk (CEO) and Andrey Bannikov (CTO) after Druk's wife, a practicing family physician, experienced the daily toll of manual charting. The company is consumer self-serve: clinicians sign up for a 7-day free trial and then a monthly Starter, Core, Premier, or custom Groups plan with no enterprise sales required. As of 2025 Freed reported more than 20,000 paying clinician users and raised a $30M Series A led by Sequoia Capital, bringing total funding to $34M. The platform is HIPAA-compliant, SOC 2 Type II certified, and HITECH-ready; patient recordings are not stored. Rather than ship a traditional public REST API, Freed pursues an "anti-integration" model in which a Chrome-extension AI agent navigates any web-based EHR (Athena, Tebra, PracticeFusion, TherapyNotes, SimplePractice, Elation, AdvancedMD, Cerbo, and others) to place the finished note in the correct fields. There is no public developer API, SDK, or open-source release.

providers.name: Offcall
providers.description: Offcall is a career and practice platform for physicians, backed by Bloomberg Beta. It provides confidential, anonymous physician salary and compensation benchmarking, and a verified clinician-to-clinician patient referrals network with HIPAA-compliant messaging for care coordination, delivered through web and mobile (iOS and Android) applications. Offcall does not currently publish a public developer API, developer portal, or OpenAPI specification; this profile was surfaced through the Bloomberg Beta portfolio and enriched with the identity and domain-security signals that are publicly available.

providers.name: TrueCare24
providers.description: TrueCare24 is a nationwide care platform providing care professionals and services for home and business. Its offerings span in-home care, on-demand healthcare staffing, visiting nurses, behavioral health and counseling, and workplace health programs including flu vaccination, diabetes screening, and COVID-19 testing and vaccination services. A 500 Global portfolio company, TrueCare24 operates customer dashboards and a provider portal but publishes no public developer program or API.

providers.name: Curve Dental
providers.description: Curve Dental is a cloud-based, all-in-one dental practice management software company founded in 2004 and headquartered in Alpharetta, Georgia. Its flagship platform, Curve Hero, serves more than 80,000 dental professionals across the United States and Canada, unifying scheduling, clinical and perio charting, imaging, billing, insurance, smart forms, reporting, patient engagement, and business analytics in a single browser-based system. Curve is privately held and backed by Battery Ventures, and connects to a growing ecosystem of integration partners (including DentalXChange, DentalHQ, Pearl AI, Bola AI, and Mango Voice) rather than exposing a public self-serve developer API. This profile was seeded from Battery Ventures' portfolio and enriched from Curve Dental's public web surface; no public OpenAPI, SDK, or developer portal was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Doctronic
providers.description: Doctronic is a consumer telemedicine platform that pairs an AI doctor with licensed physicians for anonymous, low-cost health care. Users describe their symptoms to an AI assistant that performs a free symptom assessment and health consultation, then can escalate to a real doctor for a video visit ($39/visit), prescription refills, lab orders, and follow-up care. Positioned as "Free. Anonymous. Built by doctors," the product is direct-to-consumer web and mobile rather than a developer platform: it publishes no public API, SDK, or developer documentation. The only public machine-readable surface is an RFC 9116 security.txt with a coordinated vulnerability-disclosure policy. Backed by Lightspeed Venture Partners and Union Square Ventures.

providers.name: Fertifa
providers.description: Fertifa is Europe's reproductive healthcare benefits provider for employers, giving companies a way to offer fertility, family-forming, women's health, maternity, menopause, men's reproductive health, and neurodiversity support to their employees. The platform pairs an in-house clinical team with education and training, diagnostics and testing, prescriptions and medication delivery, and financing/reimbursement, delivered to staff through a mobile app and to HR teams through enterprise and SME plans. Fertifa is London-based, backed by Speedinvest, and works with employers including Lululemon, Meta, Bain Capital, and Virgin. No public developer API or OpenAPI surface is currently published; this profile captures the company's public web, legal, and support properties.

providers.name: Flatiron Health
providers.description: Flatiron Health is a healthcare technology company focused on oncology, combining real-world data from millions of cancer patients with software and AI to support life sciences research and clinical care. Its platforms include OncoEMR and OncoCloud for oncology practices, Flatiron Vessel (clinical research EDC, formerly Protocol First) and Clinical Pipe for clinical trials, and real-world evidence products for life sciences. Flatiron data has informed thousands of peer-reviewed publications and regulatory submissions. The company is part of Roche.

providers.name: Natural Cycles
providers.description: Natural Cycles is a Swedish women's-health company behind the first birth-control application cleared by the US FDA (2018) and CE-marked in Europe as a Class IIb medical device. Its subscription app uses a proprietary temperature-based algorithm to identify fertile and non-fertile days from a user's daily basal body temperature, supporting both preventing and planning pregnancy as well as cycle, ovulation, and perimenopause tracking. Temperature is captured with a paired Bluetooth basal thermometer or through consumer wearables the app integrates with — Apple Watch, Oura Ring, and the NC B1 band. Natural Cycles publishes clinical research, an educational content library (CycleMatters), an e-commerce shop for thermometers and tests, and a public bug-bounty / responsible-disclosure program, but it does not expose a public developer API, developer portal, or OpenAPI. Backed by EQT Ventures.

providers.name: Pharmeasy
providers.description: PharmEasy is one of India's largest digital healthcare platforms, operating a consumer online pharmacy and health marketplace at pharmeasy.in. It lets users order prescription and over-the-counter medicines (with prescription upload and verification), buy health and wellness products, book diagnostic lab tests and health checkup packages, and consult doctors via telemedicine, plus a PLUS subscription for recurring savings. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Bessemer Venture Partners and Prosus Ventures and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment. PharmEasy runs an internal API at api.pharmeasy.in but publishes no public developer program, API documentation, SDKs, or OpenAPI; it does operate a responsible-disclosure security program (infosec@pharmeasy.in). Sector: healthcare / e-pharmacy.

providers.name: Tigerconnect
providers.description: TigerConnect is a healthcare clinical communication and collaboration (CC&C) platform used by 7,000+ healthcare organizations to unify secure messaging, clinical collaboration, alarm management, physician and nurse scheduling, patient engagement, nurse call, and pre-hospital care-team coordination on one activation layer. It integrates with 200+ medical devices and EHR systems and adds an AI orchestration engine (CareConduit) that routes alerts and workflows to the right clinical role at the right time. TigerConnect is recognized as a leader in the 2025 Gartner Magic Quadrant for Clinical Communications and Collaboration. The company publishes end-user product release notes, an SLA, and legal terms, but exposes no public developer API portal or OpenAPI at this time.

providers.name: Truemeds
providers.description: Truemeds is an India-based online pharmacy and digital healthcare platform operated by Intellihealth Solutions that lets consumers order branded and generic prescription and over-the-counter medicines for home delivery across India, typically positioned around savings on genuine medicines, free teleconsultation with doctors, and substitute-medicine recommendations. It runs a consumer web and mobile app experience (order medicines, upload prescriptions, health blog, help center) rather than a public developer API program; no public API documentation, developer portal, OpenAPI, or partner API surface was found during enrichment. Backed by Accel and other investors, it was added to the API Evangelist network as a company profile.

providers.name: XP Health
providers.description: XP Health is an AI-powered vision benefits platform that modernizes employer vision programs with full-replacement and dual-option plans designed to reduce employee out-of-pocket eyewear costs. The platform serves more than 6,300 organizations, offering in-app prescription renewals, virtual try-on across 5,000+ eyewear styles, and a provider network reaching 90% of the U.S. population, with members saving an average of 69% on eyewear claims. Backed by QED Investors. XP Health does not currently publish a public developer portal or API.

providers.name: Agebold
providers.description: Agebold, which operates as Bold, is a digital healthy-aging platform for adults 65 and older, delivered as a covered benefit through Medicare Advantage plans and other Medicare organizations. Bold offers personalized, science-backed exercise programs shown to reduce fall risk, ease musculoskeletal pain, and increase physical activity, alongside nutrition and weight-loss support (including GLP-1 care), live classes, expert talks, and virtual access to doctors, therapists, and nurse practitioners in select states. The company partners with health plans to improve quality measures, Star Ratings, HOS performance, and total cost of care. Agebold is a Khosla Ventures portfolio company; as of this profile it publishes no public API, developer portal, SDKs, or OpenAPI surface.

providers.name: Air Doctor
providers.description: Air Doctor is a digital health platform that connects travelers and people living abroad with a global network of vetted private doctors and specialists, offering in-person clinic visits, home visits, and telemedicine appointments in multiple languages across more than 75 countries. Users search for and book local doctors through the Air Doctor mobile app and web app, and the company operates a large B2B business embedding its provider network into travel insurance, assistance, and health-plan partners (including brands such as Allianz Global Assistance, ERGO, World Nomads, and Charles Taylor). Air Doctor is backed by Lightspeed Venture Partners. This API Evangelist profile tracks the company's public developer, partner, and web surface; Air Doctor does not publish a public API or developer portal at this time, so this profile is maintained as an identity and web-property record.

providers.name: Aletiq
providers.description: Aletiq is a French software company building a next-generation, AI-powered Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) and Product Data Management (PDM) platform for regulated manufacturers. The platform centralizes technical data (CAD files, drawings, bills of materials, configurations, and work instructions), enforces traceability and regulatory compliance, and automates business processes such as approvals, engineering change management, and project milestones. Aletiq emphasizes rapid deployment and high adoption across operational teams, and integrates with major CAD tools (SolidWorks, CATIA, Autodesk Inventor, Siemens NX, Creo) and ERP systems (SAP, Sage, Cegid, Infor, Odoo) via connectors and a custom-integration API. It serves aerospace and defense, medical devices, energy, electronics, automotive, and luxury-goods industries. Aletiq is backed by Point Nine and added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-lead profile.

providers.name: AmplifyMD
providers.description: AmplifyMD is a virtual care platform for hospitals and health systems, providing a nationwide network of remote specialists across more than 15 essential fields. It powers telemedicine across emergent, inpatient, asynchronous, SNF/LTAC, virtual clinic, and direct-to-patient care models, and integrates with major EHR systems including Epic, Oracle Health, athenahealth, Allscripts, eClinicalWorks, NextGen, TruBridge, and MedHost to help organizations build sustainable clinical staffing models. Backed by Forerunner Ventures.

providers.name: Asepha
providers.description: Asepha is an AI workflow automation platform built specifically for pharmacies, positioning itself as "the context graph for the therapy-start journey" with a stated vision to make medication delays impossible. Its AI agents automate repetitive pharmacy operations across automated prescription data entry, back-office work, 340B management (TPA matching, accruals, purchase-order automation), medication reconciliation (Best Possible Medication History), a conversational voice call assistant, benefits verification and prior-authorization (BV/PA) automation, REMS compliance reporting, and medication therapy review. The company reports outcomes such as a 32% reduction in manual labour cost within one month and tasks completed 4x faster than baseline. Asepha is SOC 2 Type 2 certified and HIPAA compliant, with AES-256 encryption at rest. Founded by CEO Eunice Wu, PharmD and CTO Can Uncu, the company operates from New York, NY and Toronto, ON, and is a Techstars portfolio company. This profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network; Asepha publishes no public API, developer portal, or specifications at this time.

providers.name: Baby2Body
providers.description: Baby2Body is the flagship consumer wellness app from Body Collective, a female-focused health and wellness company founded by sports psychologist Melinda Nicci. The app delivers personalized fitness, nutrition, and mental-health support across the fertility, pregnancy, postpartum, parenting, and broader women's-health stages, paired with an AI health coach named Bella, on-demand programs (prenatal fitness, meal plans, labor prep), expert-backed articles, and a stage-specific newsletter. Baby2Body reports over two million users and is backed by 500 Global. This profile has been enriched from the company's public consumer surfaces; no public developer portal, API, or machine-readable specification was found.

providers.name: Berry Street
providers.description: Berry Street is a telehealth platform that connects patients with board-certified, registered dietitians for virtual, insurance-covered nutrition therapy. Through 1-on-1 video sessions, patients receive medical nutrition therapy for 30+ conditions including eating disorders, diabetes, PCOS, IBS, gut health, heart disease, and prenatal and pediatric nutrition. Berry Street accepts 1,250+ insurance plans, matches patients to dietitians based on their needs, and offers an enterprise/employer offering for organizations. Backed by Northzone. This API Evangelist profile currently exposes no public developer or API surface; it is a company identity record enriched from Berry Street's public web presence.

providers.name: Boston Heart Diagnostics (Eurofins Scientific)
providers.description: Boston Heart Diagnostics is a specialty cardiovascular diagnostics laboratory, part of Eurofins Scientific, that has been improving patient outcomes since 2007 through a combination of integrated diagnostics, advanced lipid and metabolic testing, genetic risk evaluation, personalized reporting, and a scientifically designed nutrition and lifestyle program. It serves clinicians and patients through a provider portal and a patient portal (mybostonheart.com) rather than a public developer API; there is no published developer portal, OpenAPI, or programmatic surface at this time. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of bain-capital-ventures and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment; the identity and security-posture fields below are captured from the provider's public web presence.

providers.name: Bristle
providers.description: Bristle (Bristle Health) is a consumer health company that makes the world's first at-home oral microbiome saliva test, helping people measure, understand, and improve their oral health. Customers order a mail-in saliva collection kit, and Bristle sequences the oral microbiome to report on bacteria associated with cavities, gum disease, and bad breath, then pairs the results with guidance and a line of targeted oral-care products including probiotics. Bristle also works with dental professionals who offer microbiome testing to their patients. The company sells direct to consumers through a Shopify-hosted storefront at bristlehealth.com and is backed by Initialized Capital. There is no first-party public developer API; this profile captures Bristle's public web, commercial, and security surface for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: C the Signs
providers.description: C the Signs is a London-based healthcare technology company, founded in 2016 by Dr Bea Bakshi and Dr Miles Payling, that uses artificial intelligence to help clinicians detect and refer patients at risk of cancer at the earliest, most treatable stage. Registered as an MHRA Class I medical device, its clinical decision support platform analyzes more than 1,000 validated, evidence-based data points across signs, symptoms and risk factors to recommend the right investigations or urgent referrals in under 60 seconds. The platform is used widely across the UK's NHS and health systems, has helped identify over 70,000 patients with cancer across 100+ cancer types at reported 99% sensitivity, and is backed by an $8M Series A investment from Khosla Ventures. It has no public developer API; this profile tracks the company as an API Evangelist network lead.

providers.name: Caresense Pte. Ltd.
providers.description: CareSense Pte. Ltd. (CareSense.ai) is a Singapore-based preventive digital health company building AI-powered health coaching. Its flagship product is Mandy, a 24/7 AI health coach delivered over chat and voice, paired with the CareSense.ai app — a personal health dashboard covering nutrition, exercise, sleep and stress — and integrated health services including blood testing and telemedicine. The company sells both to individuals and to enterprise teams as a workplace wellbeing programme. CareSense was incorporated in Singapore on 14 June 2024 (UEN 202424008M), registered at 160 Robinson Road #14-04, and was founded by Lucas Ngoo, co-founder of Carousell, and Julian Koo, founder of the home-care platform Jaga-Me. As of this enrichment pass CareSense publishes no public API, developer portal, API documentation or SDKs; its technology surface is consumer and enterprise applications fronted by a Vanta-hosted trust center.

providers.name: Comprehensive Pharmacy Services
providers.description: Comprehensive Pharmacy Services, now operating as CPS Solutions, LLC, is a healthcare company with more than 50 years of experience providing pharmacy and hospital solutions across the care continuum. It serves independent hospitals, health systems, integrated delivery networks (IDNs), and specialized health facilities with specialty pharmacy, pharmacy management, telepharmacy (24/7/365 support), 340B program compliance, supply chain management, rehabilitation services, and consulting. The company operates two proprietary SaaS platforms — CPS Optimizer for pharmacy management and TherigySTM for specialty pharmacy management — supported by 2,500+ healthcare professionals serving 800+ customers across the United States and Puerto Rico. No public API or developer program is currently published; this profile captures the company identity and public web surface.

providers.name: Crossoverhealth
providers.description: Crossover Health is an advanced primary care provider that delivers integrated, team-based healthcare for employers and their members through its proprietary Care Platform. Its services span primary care, physical medicine, mental health, health coaching, care navigation, and occupational medicine, delivered through on-site and near-site health centers and a 50-state virtual provider network. Crossover Health is a portfolio company of Norwest Venture Partners and is tracked in the API Evangelist network as a company profile; no public developer API, developer portal, or machine-readable specification has been found on its web properties.

providers.name: Doctor on Demand
providers.description: Doctor on Demand is a telehealth platform offering 24/7 virtual medical care through video visits with board-certified clinicians. Services span urgent care, mental health therapy, psychiatry, primary care, and preventive health, with prescriptions routed to local pharmacies. Now part of Included Health, it serves consumers directly and through employer and health-plan benefit programs. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of a16z, GV, and Shasta Ventures. As of this enrichment pass Doctor on Demand publishes no public developer or partner API program; this profile carries the company identity and probed domain-security posture only.

providers.name: Fay
providers.description: Fay (Fay Health, Inc.) is a digital-health marketplace that connects members with registered dietitians and nutritionists and handles the insurance billing so nutrition counseling is covered — often at little or no out-of-pocket cost. The platform offers telehealth consultations, personalized meal planning, and support for chronic condition management, backed by iOS and Android apps and a member help center. Fay reports 4,000+ registered dietitians, 700+ accepted insurance plans, and 100,000+ members. It is backed by Forerunner Ventures and General Catalyst and is tracked in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-lead company profile; Fay publishes no public developer or API surface at this time.

providers.name: Fidocure
providers.description: FidoCure is a translational precision-medicine service for canine cancer, developed by One Health Company and backed by a16z. It combines next-generation genomic sequencing of a dog's tumor at a CLIA-certified (human-grade) lab with tumor profiling and an AI-driven data platform to identify cancer-driving mutations, then recommends personalized targeted therapeutics that veterinarians can prescribe. FidoCure has guided treatment for thousands of dogs across roughly 1,350 clinics and maintains the largest proprietary canine cancer dataset, underpinning peer-reviewed research with Stanford, the Broad Institute, Tufts, and the University of Georgia. FidoCure operates as a veterinarian-facing clinical service rather than a public developer API; this profile captures its public identity, portal, and domain-security posture for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Focused Space, Inc.
providers.description: Focused Space, Inc. operates focused.space, a consumer productivity platform built around "body doubling" — a neuroscience-backed technique where people work silently alongside others to more easily enter and sustain a flow state. The service combines 100+ weekly live sessions hosted by real humans (available 24/7) with a custom focus-video platform, a goal-setting and task-tracking app, and a community aimed at creatives, builders, remote workers, and people with ADHD. Focused Space is a 500 Global (and E14 Fund) portfolio company. It ships web, iOS, and Android apps but publishes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface at this time; this profile captures its public web and security posture.

providers.name: Folx Health
providers.description: FOLX Health is a virtual healthcare platform built for and by the LGBTQIA+ community, delivering clinician-led care through a predominantly queer and trans network of providers. Its consumer services span gender-affirming hormone therapy (HRT), PrEP and sexual & reproductive health, primary care, mental health and therapy, and fertility and family building, plus care navigation, a peer community platform, and secure provider messaging. Members access care through the web and iOS/Android apps with same or next-day appointments and insurance acceptance. FOLX is a direct-to-consumer digital health company and, as of this profile, does not publish a public developer API, developer portal, or OpenAPI specification. This entry was surfaced as a portfolio company of Bessemer Venture Partners and enriched from its public web presence.

providers.name: Foodsmart
providers.description: Foodsmart is a telenutrition company that pairs the nation's largest network of registered dietitians with a digital food-benefits platform, delivering personalized nutrition care via telehealth to more than three million members. The company partners with health plans and employers to reach Medicaid, Medicare, and commercial members, combining one-on-one dietitian counseling with meal planning, grocery ordering, and SNAP benefits enrollment. Foodsmart's "Foodscription" model connects clinical nutrition guidance to affordable, healthy food access to improve outcomes and lower the cost of diet-related chronic disease. This profile was surfaced as a Mayfield portfolio company and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline; Foodsmart exposes no public developer API, SDKs, or documentation surface at this time.

providers.name: Getteal
providers.description: Getteal (Teal Health) is a women's health company offering an FDA-authorized at-home cervical cancer screening kit, the Teal Wand, a self-collection device that lets people collect a sample privately at home and mail it to a laboratory for Primary HPV testing (the same cobas HPV test used in clinics). The service pairs the device with virtual provider consultations, a patient portal for results, insurance and HSA/FSA billing, and support for major U.S. health plans. Getteal is backed by Felicis and surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company; it is a consumer digital-health brand with no public developer program or API surface at this time.

providers.name: Guidelight Health
providers.description: Guidelight Health is a mental healthcare provider delivering evidence-based day treatment programs — Partial Hospitalization Programs (PHPs) and Intensive Outpatient Programs (IOPs) — for people managing anxiety, depression, trauma, PTSD, and personality disorders. Care combines group therapy, individual psychotherapy, and medication management, offered in-person and virtually across Colorado, California, Massachusetts, North Carolina, and Washington. Backed by GV (Google Ventures), the company operates a patient-facing clinical service rather than a public developer API; its client portal runs on the third-party Kipu (kipuworks.com) EHR platform, so there is no first-party API, SDK, or developer surface to catalog at this time.

providers.name: Harmonycares
providers.description: HarmonyCares is a physician-led, value-based, in-home primary care organization headquartered in Troy, Michigan, and one of the nation's largest house-call practices. It brings primary care, palliative care, and ancillary services such as in-home laboratory, radiology, and comprehensive health assessments directly to older adults living with serious and complex chronic conditions. Operating across roughly a dozen states, HarmonyCares supports more than 70,000 patients through value-based arrangements with Medicare Advantage plans and Medicare ACO programs. The company was surfaced through the API Evangelist network as a General Catalyst portfolio company; it publishes a public marketing site, a patient portal, and corporate policy documents, but no public developer program, API, or SDK was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Hazel Health
providers.description: Hazel Health is the nation's leading provider of school-based telehealth, delivering virtual physical and mental health care to K-12 students. Founded in 2015 and headquartered in San Francisco, California, Hazel partners directly with school districts and families to connect students with licensed, linguistically and culturally diverse clinicians and therapists — at school or at home — often within minutes for medical care and within days for teletherapy, at no cost to families. The company serves more than two million students across 100-plus districts nationwide, helping reduce chronic absenteeism and address gaps in access to care as an extension of the school health team. Hazel operates HIPAA- and FERPA-compliant systems with full encryption and secure access controls. It is a B2B/B2G healthcare provider and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal.

providers.name: Heartbeat Health
providers.description: Heartbeat Health is a New York-based modern cardiology practice delivering remote and virtual cardiovascular care. The company combines early detection, home-based cardiac diagnostics, remote patient monitoring, risk stratification and evidence-based care coordination to proactively identify, treat and manage moderate-to-high cardiovascular risk. It serves hospitals and health systems, payors and employer groups, providers and ACOs, and in-home care providers, reporting outcomes such as 90%+ of patients reaching target blood pressure and a 53% reduction in cardiac readmissions. Backed by Optum Ventures, DaVita Venture Group and Echo Health Ventures, it is a care-delivery organization rather than a public API provider; no developer portal, API documentation, or public API surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Imperfect
providers.description: Imperfect (Imperfect Wellness, Inc.) is a San Francisco-based, Y Combinator-backed (Spring 2026) consumer startup building an adaptive AI training coach for endurance athletes across cycling, trail running, swimming, and other sports. The mobile app connects to a user's wearables and health apps to generate real-time training, recovery, and nutrition recommendations that adapt to how the athlete's body is actually responding day to day, rather than following a static plan written weeks in advance. Founded by Matin Tamizi (previously built and sold two fintech companies and authored a widely used open-source Garmin library used by Stanford Health). Imperfect ships as a consumer mobile application (Google Play) and publishes no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal at this time.

providers.name: Inkblot Therapy
providers.description: Inkblot Therapy is a Canadian digital mental health platform, part of GreenShield, that delivers secure virtual therapy and counselling online. It matches individuals to licensed counsellors, social workers, psychotherapists, and psychologists using a clinically designed questionnaire, and delivers confidential video sessions. Inkblot serves individuals directly, employers and organizations through Employee Assistance Programs (EAP) and mental health benefits, and practitioners who provide care on the platform. The company operates consumer and business web applications (app.inkblottherapy.com, business.inkblottherapy.com) but does not publish a public developer program, API documentation, SDKs, or an OpenAPI description. This profile was surfaced as a Techstars portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network as a lead; enrichment reflects the public web and DNS/security surface only.

providers.name: Joyful
providers.description: Joyful Health provides AI-assisted revenue recovery for healthcare organizations, combining automated claim investigation with expert billing teams to recover unpaid and denied insurance claims. Its platform runs inside an organization's existing revenue-cycle-management (RCM) systems rather than replacing them, covering denial investigation and root-cause analysis, claims recovery and appeals management, historical accounts-receivable (A/R) assessment, payer follow-up, documentation review, and financial insight to prevent future denials. The company operates a customer application at app.joyfulhealth.io and maintains a Vanta-hosted trust center. Joyful is a portfolio company of CRV. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a lead; Joyful does not currently publish a public API or developer program.

providers.name: Meru Health
providers.description: Meru Health is a digital mental health company delivering a therapist-guided 12-week program for anxiety, depression, stress, and burnout. The platform blends licensed-therapist video sessions, an on-demand app of mindfulness and behavioral practices, an HRV biofeedback wearable, and anonymous peer support. Sold B2B2C to health plans and employers as a covered benefit, it is measurement-based and outcomes-focused. No public developer API, portal, SDK, or documentation surface was found during enrichment; this profile captures the company identity plus a probed domain-security posture.

providers.name: Motivo
providers.description: Motivo is the leading managed clinical supervision platform for behavioral health organizations. It connects pre-licensed and post-graduate mental health professionals with 1,500+ vetted clinical supervisors across all 50 states, enabling organizations to expand their workforce, reduce burnout, and meet licensure requirements. The fully-managed platform handles supervisor vetting, compliance and documentation, scheduling, HIPAA-compliant video sessions, and payment processing, and includes group supervision, peer consultation, webinars, and workforce-development resources. Motivo serves behavioral health centers, treatment facilities, health plans, and digital health companies. As of this profile Motivo publishes no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; its platform is delivered as a managed SaaS product and it consumes third-party APIs (e.g. Google Calendar) internally.

providers.name: myLaurel
providers.description: myLaurel is a New York-based healthcare company delivering acute and transitional care in patients' homes. Its hybrid model pairs hands-on clinical teams with virtual technology support to prevent unnecessary hospitalizations, free critical hospital bed space, improve patient outcomes, and lower the total cost of care for both health systems and health plans. Reported results include a 49% reduction in 30-day readmissions, an average 1.5-day length-of-stay reduction, a 97 Net Promoter Score, and 3:1+ ROI within 90 days. myLaurel is a portfolio company of GV (Google Ventures). This profile has been enriched from the company's public web surface; it currently exposes no public developer API.

providers.name: Nectar
providers.description: Nectar (Nectar Life Sciences) is a hybrid, vertically-integrated allergy care platform combining at-home testing with in-person clinical care. Patients can self-test for dozens of indoor and outdoor environmental allergens using mail-in home kits, then receive personalized treatment including sublingual immunotherapy (allergy drops), prescription nasal sprays, rescue inhalers, and allergy shots. Its flagship Nectar Allergy Center in New York City treats adults and children for environmental allergies, asthma, food allergies, and eczema, alongside virtual telehealth appointments. Nectar is a consumer healthcare provider with no public developer API surface; it was backed by Obvious Ventures, Juxtapose, and Harmony Partners.

providers.name: Ollie
providers.description: Ollie (ollie.com, formerly myollie.com) is a direct-to-consumer pet health company that makes fresh, human-grade dog food tailored to each dog. Customers build a personalized meal plan from their dog's profile (breed, age, weight, activity, allergies), and Ollie delivers pre-portioned, chef-and-vet-developed recipes on a recurring subscription, along with app-based health tracking and check-ins. The company reports having served more than one million dogs. Ollie is a venture-backed consumer brand and a portfolio company of Canaan Partners; it operates as a subscription e-commerce and mobile-app business and does not publish a public developer platform, API, or developer documentation.

providers.name: Pair Team
providers.description: Pair Team, PBC is a healthcare care-coordination company that pairs clinical care teams with technology to deliver comprehensive care management for underserved and vulnerable populations. It runs Enhanced Care Management for Medi-Cal (California Medicaid) members and a Medicare support program, coordinating housing assistance, food access, behavioral and mental health support, appointment scheduling, medication management, and transportation for people managing chronic conditions and social determinants of health. Its Flora AI care advocate helps triage and connect members to resources and escalates to clinical staff. Backed by Craft Ventures. Pair Team publishes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface at this time; this profile captures its company identity and public web properties.

providers.name: Parallel Learning
providers.description: Parallel Learning is a special education services and staffing platform that connects K-12 schools and districts with a nationwide network of licensed clinicians for the remote delivery of specialized student support. Through its proprietary, HIPAA/FERPA-compliant Pathway platform it delivers virtual psychoeducational and neurodevelopmental assessments, speech-language therapy, behavioral and mental-health counseling, specialized instruction in reading, writing, and math, and executive-function coaching, pairing secure teletherapy with progress tracking and clinical oversight so districts can meet compliance requirements and improve student outcomes. The company serves thousands of students across dozens of states and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or API documentation surface.

providers.name: Pawp
providers.description: Pawp is a veterinary telemedicine membership service that gives pet owners 24/7 access to licensed veterinary professionals via text, video, and phone. For a flat annual membership, members get unlimited on-demand consultations with vets, nurses, and technicians who each carry a minimum of five years of clinical experience, along with personalized care plans and follow-up guidance for both emergencies and routine questions. Pawp operates as a consumer mobile app (iOS and Android) with no public developer API, SDK, or partner integration surface. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of dcm-ventures and lux-capital and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment.

providers.name: PB Health
providers.description: PB Health (PB Healthcare Service Pvt Ltd) is an India-based consumer healthcare network offering end-to-end care through a single app - online doctor consultations, hospital visits and admissions, lab tests and radiology scans, medicine ordering, diabetes and obesity management, preventive health packages, and structured home care and recovery. The platform spans top specialities including cardiology, gastroenterology, orthopaedics, pulmonology, internal medicine, gynaecology, ENT, paediatrics, and minimal-access and bariatric surgery, and helps families coordinate their complete health and insurance journey. PB Health is a consumer mobile application (iOS and Android) and website; it does not publish a public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation.

providers.name: PeopleOne Health
providers.description: PeopleOne Health is a nationwide provider of value-based, employer-funded advanced primary care, delivering comprehensive physical and mental health services with no copays, deductibles, or coinsurance for members. Its model pairs dedicated care teams with a prevention-first approach to lower total cost of care for self-funded employers while improving member health outcomes, and it was named a 2024 Best Nationwide Primary Care Provider by the Validation Institute. Surfaced as a portfolio company of GV, PeopleOne Health operates as a healthcare services provider rather than an API platform: member access is delivered through a healow-based patient portal and a member portal, and no public developer API, OpenAPI specification, or developer documentation is published.

providers.name: Phil
providers.description: PHIL (PHILRx) is a healthtech company operating a digital hub and direct-to-patient platform that helps pharmaceutical brands maximize prescription starts, insurance coverage, affordability, and medication adherence. Its all-in-one platform connects pharma manufacturers, patients, and healthcare providers to streamline the prescription access experience, run affordable direct-to-patient and cash-pay programs, and improve commercial performance across the medication access journey. PHIL is a portfolio company of Uncork Capital. As of this enrichment pass it exposes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface; this profile captures its identity and probed domain-security posture.

providers.name: Plenna
providers.description: Plenna is a women's healthcare provider operating a network of integrated medical clinics across Mexico City, redefining health for women across every life stage. Its services span gynecology, maternity and prenatal care, fertility, menopause, contraception, gynecological surgery, psychology, nutrition, laboratory studies, vaccines and lactation support, delivered across six physical clinics (Tlalpan, Coapa, Del Valle, Polanco, San Angel and Satelite) and through Portal Plenna, a patient portal and iOS/Android mobile app for scheduling appointments, virtual consultations, test results, prescriptions and pregnancy tracking. Plenna is a 500 Global portfolio company. It is surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a company profile; no public developer API surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Provide
providers.description: Provide is a financial services division of Fifth Third Bank offering banking and financing built specifically for owners of professional practices — dental, medical, veterinary, optometry, childcare, financial advisory, funeral, and insurance businesses. The company provides conventional and SBA loans to start, acquire, or expand a practice, alongside a full suite of customized banking products. Provide was acquired by Fifth Third Bank and operates as a specialty lending and banking brand. Surfaced as a portfolio company of QED Investors; it publishes no public developer API, documentation, or developer portal at this time.

providers.name: Qventus
providers.description: Qventus is a healthcare technology company that provides an AI-powered automation platform for hospital operations. Its "AI teammates" combine machine learning, generative AI, and behavioral science to streamline care-coordination workflows across surgical growth and operating-room utilization, perioperative and pre-admission-testing coordination, inpatient capacity and discharge planning, and care-gap and coding automation. Qventus sells to health systems and hospitals as a B2B SaaS product and does not currently publish a public developer API, developer portal, or SDKs; this profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network as a company record. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Bessemer Venture Partners, Mayfield, Norwest Venture Partners, and Y Combinator.

providers.name: Radish Health
providers.description: Radish Health is a healthcare company that provides employers with a modern employee health benefit, pairing each member with a dedicated care team and physicians who handle medical issues directly or coordinate specialist referrals. The service emphasizes direct-access primary care over phone, video, and in-person visits, with rapid response times and appointment coordination aimed at reducing employer healthcare costs while improving the patient experience. Radish Health is delivered through patient-facing web and mobile apps (iOS and Android) and an employer benefits program; it is a Techstars portfolio company. As of this enrichment pass, Radish Health publishes no public API, developer portal, or technical documentation — this profile captures its identity, legal/support surfaces, and domain security posture only.

providers.name: Rezilient Health
providers.description: Rezilient Health is an employer-sponsored primary and specialty care provider that combines physical CloudClinics with telehealth to deliver unlimited, zero-cost care to employees on behalf of employers, health plans, health systems, and brokers. Its hybrid CloudClinic model pairs on-site medical staff with remote physicians and connected diagnostic equipment so members can access in-person and virtual visits, with the goal of lowering total healthcare spend and improving clinical outcomes. Rezilient offers patient-facing web and mobile apps for scheduling and care, but publishes no public developer portal, API, SDK, or documentation surface. This profile was surfaced as a Techstars portfolio company and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline; the honest result is that Rezilient operates a consumer/enterprise healthcare service rather than a developer platform.

providers.name: Salvo Health
providers.description: Salvo Health is a virtual care company delivering continuous gastrointestinal and metabolic care through integrated, tech-enabled clinical teams. Its platform pairs registered dietitians, licensed nurses, and behavioral health specialists with a patient mobile app and remote patient monitoring to manage conditions including IBS, obesity, GLP-1/anti-obesity therapy, and fatty liver disease (MASH/MASLD). Adherence data and monthly patient reports are integrated directly into provider EHR systems. Salvo Health is a portfolio company of Threshold Ventures. As of this profile the company exposes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface; this record captures its public identity and web properties for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Season Health
providers.description: Season Health is a food-as-medicine platform that helps people living with chronic conditions eat well and live well. It connects patients with registered dietitians, personalized nutrition and meal plans, and medically-tailored groceries and meals, and works with health plans and care providers to deliver nutrition care as a covered benefit. The consumer and provider experiences run through app.seasonhealth.com; the company is a HIPAA-covered digital health service. Season Health is backed by a16z. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes no public developer API, documentation, or SDKs — api.seasonhealth.com is a private application backend — so this profile captures the company's real public web properties rather than an API program.

providers.name: Sira Medical
providers.description: Sira Medical develops augmented reality software that transforms 3D radiological imaging into patient-specific holographic models projected onto real-world backgrounds. Delivered through head-mounted AR devices (such as Microsoft HoloLens) and mobile platforms, the technology helps surgeons perform preoperative planning with greater confidence, clinicians educate patients with understandable visualizations, medical schools train students on patient-specific anatomy, and medical-device makers design and validate implants. The company is backed by 500 Global, Eileses Capital, UCSF Innovation Ventures, and Microsoft for Startups. Sira Medical operates as a clinical AR software vendor and does not currently expose a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; this profile captures its public identity, legal, and domain-security posture for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Solace Health
providers.description: Solace Health (solace.health) is a US healthcare navigation and patient-advocacy platform that matches patients and family caregivers with dedicated advocates, many covered by insurance, to handle administrative tasks, coordinate care and referrals, and fight for approvals and treatments. Advocates support members by video, phone, text, and email nationwide across a range of insurance plans, with a member app at app.solace.health. The company is venture-backed (IVP among its investors). As of this enrichment pass, Solace publishes a patient-facing service only and exposes no public developer API, API documentation, or developer portal.

providers.name: Sunnyside
providers.description: Sunnyside is a digital health platform for alcohol moderation, founded in 2020, that helps members cut back on or quit drinking through personalized weekly plans, drink tracking and analytics, human text-based coaching, habit-building exercises, and a supportive community. Its separate Sunnyside Med telehealth service connects members with licensed providers who can prescribe compounded naltrexone. Sunnyside is a consumer mobile app and telehealth service and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or developer documentation. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Uncork Capital.

providers.name: Synapticure
providers.description: Synapticure is a virtual-first telehealth company delivering comprehensive, specialist neurology care for people living with neurodegenerative and complex neurological conditions, including ALS/PLS, Parkinson's, Alzheimer's, dementia, Huntington's, and multiple sclerosis. Founded in 2021 by ALS patient Brian Wallach and caregiver Sandra Abrevaya, the company integrates 24/7 access to neurologists, behavioral health (psychiatry and therapy), care coordination, genetic testing, clinical-trial navigation, and insurance support into a single virtual care experience available in all 50 states and covered by most insurance. It is accredited by The Joint Commission and maintains AICPA SOC 2 compliance. Synapticure operates as a healthcare provider and does not publish a public developer program or API; this profile was surfaced as a GV portfolio company and enriched with real, published identity and security signals.

providers.name: Tend
providers.description: Tend (Tend Dental) is a consumer dental-care company offering modern, judgment-free dentistry through a network of design-forward "studios" across New York City, Boston, Atlanta, Washington DC, Nashville and Connecticut. The brand pairs a soothing in-person studio experience and top-rated dentists with a fully online booking and patient-intake flow at hellotend.com. Services span preventive hygiene, family dental care, cosmetic dentistry, veneers, Invisalign and clear aligners, orthodontics, dental implants, endodontics, sedation and emergency care. Backed by GV and Redpoint Ventures. This is a consumer web/ booking business with no public developer API surface; the profile is enriched with identity, security-posture and discovery-probe artifacts only.

providers.name: VetSource
providers.description: VetSource is a veterinary technology and pharmacy company founded in 2008 that delivers a suite of pharmacy, technology, and business services for the pet health industry. Its offerings span home-delivery prescription management (an online pharmacy and prescription workflow that lets veterinary practices prescribe and fulfill medications with compliance and revenue tools), the Vet2Pet client-engagement platform (a custom-branded app connecting practices with pet owners for communication, reminders, loyalty, and telehealth), and data/analytics services that provide industry benchmarking and practice performance insights. VetSource serves veterinary practices and pet owners across North America. No public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation is published; this profile captures the company identity and probed domain-security posture.

providers.name: WeiMai
providers.description: WeiMai (微脉) is a Chinese healthcare technology company operated by Choice Technology Inc. and headquartered in Hangzhou. It runs an internet-based medical services marketplace and licensed internet hospitals (including Hainan WeiMai Internet Hospital) that connect patients with doctors for online consultation, pharmaceutical products, medical devices, and health-management service packages, delivered primarily through the WeiMai consumer mobile app. WeiMai also operates a partner-facing Open Platform (微脉开发平台) at openapi.myweimai.com that exposes a Swagger 2.0 API surface for approved integrators; the public specification is a minimal stub with no operations exposed without partner credentials. The company is backed by IDG Capital and was added to the API Evangelist network as a healthcare portfolio company.

providers.name: ZOE
providers.description: ZOE (joinzoe.com, canonically zoe.com) is a personalized nutrition and health science company founded on data from one of the largest nutrition research studies in the world. Its membership program pairs at-home testing (gut health, blood sugar, and blood fat responses) with an AI-powered app that scores meals, tracks personal food responses, and delivers science-backed dietary guidance. ZOE also sells consumer products including the Daily30+ whole-food supplement and Gut Health products, and publishes the ZOE Science & Nutrition podcast. The company operates as a direct-to-consumer health brand rather than an API provider, and is tracked here as a Balderton Capital portfolio company; it currently exposes no public developer platform, API, or developer portal.

providers.name: Bariendo Inc.
providers.description: Bariendo Inc. (now operating as Everself) is a science-forward digital health company pioneering non-surgical, endoscopic weight-loss care. Founded in 2023 by Harvard Medical School physicians Dr. Christopher C. Thompson (the inventor of Endoscopic Sleeve Gastroplasty) and Dr. Pichamol Jirapinyo, the company delivers minimally invasive procedures — ESG Stomach Tightening, gastric balloon, and revision of prior bariatric surgery — alongside weight-loss medication and a 12-month concierge care program. Its consumer platform streamlines access to these interventions across a dozen-plus U.S. locations, with financing, telehealth consultations, and ongoing weight tracking. Bariendo/Everself is a consumer and clinical health service; it publishes no public developer portal, API, or SDK surface.

providers.name: Better Life Partners
providers.description: Better Life Partners is a Hanover, New Hampshire healthcare provider founded in 2018 that delivers same-day, whole-person treatment for opioid and alcohol use disorder across New Hampshire, Maine, Massachusetts, Vermont and North Carolina. It combines FDA-approved medication for addiction treatment (buprenorphine/Suboxone, naltrexone) with group counseling, peer recovery coaching and mental health care, delivered both virtually and in person, on a non-punitive harm-reduction model. The company contracts directly with Medicaid, Medicare and commercial health plans — MaineCare, NH Healthy Families, Anthem, Cigna, Harvard Pilgrim, Tufts, Humana and UnitedHealthcare — and markets value-based arrangements "from bundles to full risk" to payers and community partners. It is a clinical services organization rather than a software vendor: it references "purpose-built technology" internally but publishes no developer program, API, specification, SDK or integration documentation of any kind.

providers.name: City Block
