It reports roughly 300 sleep health professionals, Joint Commission accreditation held for over 15 years, and SOC 2 Type II compliance, and in 2026 acquired Coastal Sleep Diagnostics and Epoch Sleep Centers. BetterNight is a healthcare services operator, not an API platform: it publishes no developer program, API documentation, or machine-readable specification.

providers.name: Denta
providers.description: Denta is a San Francisco-based dental practice management and automation platform, founded by Jack Beecher (Jack Beecher LLC, dba Denta) and backed by Y Combinator (Summer 2026 batch). Positioned as "the dental practice that runs itself," Denta embeds AI into dental organizations to automate back-office operations: it ingests fragmented data from a practice's existing software, provides analytics so dentists can understand their business, and runs in the background to handle administrative work such as insurance payment posting. Its roadmap includes all-in-one native practice management software and an "autonomous dental practice." As of this profile Denta publishes a marketing site, a blog, and login and legal pages, but no public developer portal, API, or OpenAPI surface has been located.

providers.name: DietlyAPI
providers.description: Food & nutrition data REST API with 4.2M+ foods, calories, macros, 17 micronutrients, barcode lookup, and confidence-ranked full-text search. Data primarily from Open Food Facts (ODbL), EU-hosted, with key-optional read access.

providers.name: ElCoach
providers.description: ElCoach (الكوتش) is a Cairo, Egypt based fitness and nutrition technology company serving the Middle East and North Africa. Its bilingual Arabic/English mobile app delivers personalized workout routines and healthy meal plans tailored to each user, combining certified trainers and nutritionists with AI-driven personalization. The product is a consumer subscription app distributed on iOS and Android with in-app payments; it does not publish a public developer API program. ElCoach is backed by 500 Global (500 Startups), Endure Capital, Wise Capital, and the Misk 500 MENA and Google accelerators, and was added to the API Evangelist network as a 500 Global portfolio company.

providers.name: Luminai
providers.description: Luminai is an AI-powered automation platform for health system operations, marketed as "The AI Platform for Health System Operations." It automates complex, high-volume healthcare back-office workflows including referral intake and processing, provider inbox automation, patient registration, orders and referrals, pharmacy renewals, payor contract management, denial appeals, and underpayment recovery. The company reports over 12 million automations driven, an average 5.3x ROI, and a 48-day average time to value, with enterprise-grade security and flexible deployment options (on-premises, VPC, or fully managed). Luminai is SOC 2, HIPAA, and GDPR compliant. It is a venture-backed company in the General Catalyst portfolio. Luminai does not publish a public developer API, API documentation, or developer portal at this time; this profile captures its public identity and security posture.

providers.name: Mindful Health Solutions
providers.description: Mindful Health Solutions is a behavioral-health-care provider specializing in innovative, evidence-based psychiatric treatments for depression, anxiety, PTSD, OCD, and other treatment-resistant conditions. Founded in 2007 (originally as TMS Health Solutions) by Dr. Richard Bermudes, the company pioneered TMS-focused clinics in the United States and offers Transcranial Magnetic Stimulation (TMS), SPRAVATO (esketamine) nasal spray, IV Ketamine infusion therapy, medication management, and psychiatric care across roughly 20 clinics in California, Texas, and Washington. Mindful Health Solutions maintains one of the world's largest TMS and esketamine patient-outcome repositories. It is a portfolio company of Norwest Venture Partners. As a clinical healthcare provider it publishes no public developer API; this profile captures its identity, an AI-crawler llms.txt it publishes, and its domain-security posture.

providers.name: Nutrisystem (Wellina by Nutrisystem)
providers.description: Nutrisystem is a direct-to-consumer subscription meal delivery service for weight loss, founded in 1972 by Harold Katz and headquartered in Fort Washington, Pennsylvania. The company pioneered prepackaged weight-loss meal subscriptions, transitioned from physical retail to a direct-to-consumer Internet and telephone model in 1999, and added mobile delivery beginning in 2010. Nutrisystem is now operated under the marketing umbrella "Wellina by Nutrisystem" — a multi-brand health and wellness marketplace covering Nutrisystem, Jenny Craig, High Protein, Menopause Support, Low Carb (GLP-1 friendly), and the Club Advantage à la carte membership. The legal operating entity is Nutrisystem, LLC, a subsidiary of Wellful, Inc. (the parent organization formed after Kainos Capital acquired Nutrisystem from Tivity Health in October 2020). Tivity Health no longer owns the brand. Wellful's portfolio also includes South Beach Diet (acquired by Nutrisystem in December 2015 for $15 million) and the Jenny Craig intellectual property (acquired by Wellful in fall 2023 after Jenny Craig's Chapter 7 bankruptcy and relaunched as an e-commerce meal-delivery brand). LinkedIn classifies the company under Wellness and Fitness Services with 501–1,000 employees. Stephen Mikulak was named President in 2021. Nutrisystem publishes no public developer APIs, OpenAPI specs, SDKs, or developer portal. Its only digital surface beyond the e-commerce sites is the consumer-facing Nutrisystem mobile app (iOS / Android) for food logging, weight tracking, journaling, and meal-plan adjustments — and the equivalent Jenny Craig app — neither of which advertise integrations with Apple Health, Google Fit, Fitbit, or any third-party platform. The github.com/nutrisystem GitHub organization exists but contains a single inactive CSS repository last updated in March 2015. The technology footprint is a closed consumer subscription stack with no public developer touchpoints.

providers.name: Rad AI
providers.description: Rad AI is a San Francisco based healthcare technology company that builds generative and machine-learning software for radiology. Its products help radiologists work faster and reduce burnout: Rad AI Reporting is a generative AI reporting platform, Rad AI Impressions automatically generates customized report impressions (reported to save radiologists 60+ minutes per shift), and Rad AI Continuity manages follow-up of incidental findings. The company is SOC 2 Type II and HIPAA certified and is backed by Khosla Ventures. Rad AI markets its clinical products directly to health systems and imaging groups and does not currently publish a public developer API, developer portal, or SDKs; this profile captures its identity, security posture, and compliance program for the API Evangelist network.
